ExchangeFolderId.description: The ID of the Exchange folder in the folder-level tracking rule.

ExchangeFolderName.description: The name of the Exchange folder in the folder-level tracking rule.

IsFolderOnboarded.description: Whether the tracking rule for the folder has run.

RegardingObjectId.description: The ID of the entity record with which the Exchange folder is mapped.

RegardingObjectName.description: The name of the entity represented by the RegardingObjectId property.

RegardingObjectTypeCode.description: The entity type code of the entity represented by the RegardingObjectId property.
